 A partly flooded road in Hat Yai district Tuesday night. Aswin Pakkawan 
 Authorities are fully prepared to manage flooding in Songkhla's Hat Yai district, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, as heavy rainfall raises concerns about a repeat of last year's severe floods.
